authors_private_dataset.description: Curated private contract corpus for legal clause extraction
authors_private_dataset.data_availability_statement: Access to the curated private contract dataset (approx. 200 contracts) may be granted upon reasonable request to the corresponding author (william.villegas@udla.edu.ec), subject to legal and ethical constraints.

waiting_periods.reason: CUAD/LexGLUE do not contain consumer medical waiting period clauses.

sub_limits_and_caps.reason: Commercial liability caps do not represent medical room rent or cataract caps.

non_payable_items_and_consumables.reason: CUAD/LexGLUE do not contain excluded hospital consumable items.

co_payment_mandates.reason: CUAD/LexGLUE do not contain patient percentage co-pay mandates.

standard_coverage.reason: Commercial insurance mandates differ from consumer inpatient hospitalisation coverage.

comparison_with_current_dataset2.repetition: 23 unique template text strings repeated 38-40 times across 40 policy IDs.
comparison_with_current_dataset2.recommendation: Do not use current Dataset 2 for ground-truth supervised fine-tuning; treat as synthetic baseline only.

experimental_recommendations: 1. Do not claim the paper provides a public 5-class insurance dataset.
2. Use CUAD for legal-domain pre-training / transfer learning experiments if desired.
3. Obtain user approval on whether to use real policy PDF extraction or manual annotation for Dataset 2.
